entities.summary: Uwe Lulis is a German guitarist. He is known for being the playing guitar in Grave Digger for about 13 years, for whom he co-wrote many songs during his time in the band. After leaving Grave Digger Lulis and Tomi Göttlich, former bassist of Grave Digger, formed the heavy metal band Rebellion in 2000. Lulis and two other members left Rebellion in 2010.
